environment.cold_definition: new controller in the same process; first sample of each case retained as warmup; OS/framework caches are not cleared
environment.fixture: charging / all modules / Top 3 detailed / 60 history samples
environment.observation: continuous NSApp.run; approximately 1 ms asynchronous polling; forced explicitly submits layout/display/CA before observing; natural adds no harness submission. A nonempty presentation layer and effectiveAppearance are software state, not proof of a newly displayed theme or physical frame delivery. Entrance removal has a bounded 3-second observation and retains censored samples; closing must clear the key.
environment.open_external_refreshes: skipped; synchronous UI path only; sampling measured separately
